active_milestone: COMPLETE (+ real-world eval + universal multi-language parser)

multi_language.engine: tree-sitter + tree-sitter-language-pack (core deps; prebuilt wheels, no compiler)
multi_language.design: All code parsing routes through parsers/code.py:parse_code_source (ext dispatch). Change detection is language-agnostic via structured CodeUnit.params (models.Param) — classify.py + mock.py read impact.old_params/new_params, no per-language regex. Router degrades to [] on missing grammar / bad file (CI-safe). Same detect->map->verify->repair->PR flow; nothing forked.
multi_language.evidence: 106 tests pass (was 96): +tests/unit/test_parse_{typescript,javascript,java}.py + tests/unit/test_multilang_e2e.py (analyze() heals a real TS repo + flags a Java rename end-to-end). ruff+mypy clean (38 files). Adversarial workflow (6 agents) found+fixed real extraction bugs: TS parenless arrow, JS generators, Java enum methods.
multi_language.deploy_verified: GitHub Action Docker image builds (python:3.11-slim, exit 0, 107MB) with tree-sitter in core deps; container CLI runs and grammars load+parse TS/Java inside the image. action.yml/entrypoint unchanged.
known_limitations: getter/setter with same name collide on (qualified_name, kind) — one overwrites the other (info loss, no false positive).
overloaded Java methods collide on the same key; constructors + nested-class methods + @interface not extracted (deliberate).
TS class-field arrow properties (handler = (e) => ...) and destructured params are skipped.

real_world_eval.findings: Zero false positives on real repos. Session-3 fresh repo = httpx (tutorial-heavy docs): mock eval 12/12 targets, precision=recall=F1=1.0, fp=0 (mapping-precision fix holds on a repo full of quickstart/async/advanced prose). Real DeepSeek eval on generic first-param targets (method/url) correctly declined to flag -> conservative, not a false positive. real-LLM REPAIR NO-CHANGE BUG FIXED + live-confirmed: Pydantic Field(frozen->is_frozen) and httpx follow_redirects->allow_redirects both verdict=stale conf=1.0 with repair changed=True, fixing BOTH prose and the code-example line (mock only patched backticked prose).
real_world_eval.real_llm: OpenAI-compatible NVIDIA endpoint wired via .env (DOCGUARD_OPENAI_BASE_URL, model deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash). Works; slow ~30-70s/call. Repro: scripts/real_case_demo.py (pydantic), scripts/httpx_case_demo.py (httpx).

NEW (session-3 finding): real-LLM full-section rewrite made a COLLATERAL edit -- HTML-escaped '>>>' -> '>>>' in an untouched pycon block on the httpx case. The intended change was correct but byte-for-byte preservation of unrelated lines is not guaranteed on the real path (mock's surgical regex swap is).
